parameters.content:
## Stage 6 — OJS BOQ & SMV

1. Read Operative Job Sheet + BOQ tab
2. **Only process rows where BOQ_Checked is empty or FALSE**
3. Fetch **full works index** (all pages via API pagination)
4. Fetch BOQ in batches of 3
5. Append to OJS BOQ & SMV tab
6. Set **BOQ_Checked = TRUE** on Operative Job Sheet for fetched jobs

nodes.name: Set API params3
nodes.note: Server API on port 8000 (same host as OJS extraction)

nodes.name: Fetch Works Index1
nodes.note: Only runs when Preview found pending jobs

nodes.name: Startup: Fix Duplicates & Sync1
nodes.note: Remove no-SOR duplicates + sync BOQ_Checked + clear accumulators

nodes.name: IF startup has work1
nodes.note: true only when duplicate no-SOR rows need deleting (dupCount > 0)

nodes.name: Delete duplicate no-SOR rows1
nodes.note: Removes old no-SOR placeholder rows when real SOR rows exist for same address (only runs when dupCount > 0)

nodes.name: Update Operative BOQ_Checked (startup)1
nodes.note: Sync BOQ_Checked + Reason

nodes.name: Build jobs to fetch1
nodes.note: BOQ_Checked empty/false only; resolve works_id from full works index

nodes.name: Loop BOQ batches1
nodes.note: 3 jobs at a time — accumulates all results before downstream

nodes.name: Fetch BOQ batch1
nodes.note: Main loop — result stored, loop continues

nodes.name: Accumulate main results1
nodes.note: Saves results to static data → loops back to continue

nodes.name: Emit main results1
nodes.note: Fires once after ALL main batches finish → sends full list to Calc

nodes.name: Calc SMV and build rows1
nodes.note: Processes ALL batch results at once — SMV x 80% x qty

nodes.name: Prepare BOQ_Checked updates1
nodes.note: TRUE + SOR Checked when SOR lines found OR 0 rows confirmed on BOQ tab

nodes.name: Update Operative BOQ_Checked1
nodes.note: Marks BOQ_Checked on Operative Job Sheet

nodes.name: Route post-update1
nodes.note:
true → Summarize (retry pass done)
false → Collect retry jobs (main pass done)

nodes.name: IF route after update1
nodes.note:
true (retry pass) → Summarize
false (main pass) → Collect retry jobs

nodes.name: Fetch BOQ batch (retry)1
nodes.note: Retry loop — result stored, loop continues

nodes.name: Accumulate retry results1
nodes.note: Saves retry results → loops back

nodes.name: Emit retry results1
nodes.note: Fires once after ALL retry batches finish

nodes.name: Read OJS BOQ before replace1
nodes.note: Fresh read before replace — avoids duplicate rows on re-run

nodes.name: Prepare replace existing rows1
nodes.note: Find all sheet rows for jobs being written → delete before append

nodes.name: Delete existing BOQ rows1
nodes.note: Remove old rows for same address/job before writing new ones
